rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides access to UK Parliamentary data through the Parliament API and semantic search capabilities over Hansard debates and Parliamentary Questions. Built by i.AI using Python with FastAPI and Elasticsearch, it offers 11 specialized tools including constituency and member searches, election results, government/opposition post listings, and semantic search through parliamentary debates and written questions using Azure OpenAI embeddings. The implementation features automated daily data ingestion via AWS Lambda, comprehensive member information with voting records and interests, flexible date-based searches with natural language parsing, and full AWS deployment with Terraform infrastructure, making it valuable for political research, parliamentary monitoring, policy analysis workflows, and building AI assistants that need programmatic access to UK Parliament data without manual website navigation.
